Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.pepys

Enum Class ObservedActivity

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ObservedActivity>
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.pepys.ObservedActivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ObservedActivity>, Constable
public enum ObservedActivity extends Enum<ObservedActivity>
ObservedActivity maps each of the anchor element activity messages that the metadata access servers write to their audit log onto the UsageActivity count that it increments. The anchor element that the activity is about is always the third message parameter ({2}), and the calling user is the first ({0}). The creation of an anchor element (METADATA-OBSERVABILITY-0001) is not counted.
